title: Probing LoRA-to-LoRA Cross-Lingual Transfer for Unseen Low-Resource Conditions in Whisper-Based ASR
read_scope: Read official ISCA metadata and abstract; methods 3.1-3.3; dataset, donor-recipient setup and training 4.1-4.3; tables 2-4, results 5.1-5.2 and conclusion. PDF is 5 pages. No code or experiment rerun.
key_evidence: Whisper-small, LoRA rank 32 on attention and feed-forward projections in both encoder and decoder; donor LoRA weights initialize a recipient LoRA, with recipient data then used for adaptation. Donors: Hindi 600 h, Bengali 600 h, Marathi 550 h. Recipient conditions: Bhojpuri 40/80 h, Assamese 40 h, Konkani 60/100 h. The authors report relative WER reductions of 9-17% against recipient-only LoRA. A concrete near-neighbor; its donor-initialization and JS orthographic-divergence idea cannot be claimed as new.
